sentences.en: The theft of Peruvian resources perpetrated by the Spanish was huge.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人犯下的对秘鲁资源的盗窃行为非常巨大。

sentences.en: Some of the massacres the French perpetrated in Algeria reached Holocaust proportions.
sentences.zh: 法国人在阿尔及利亚犯下的某些屠杀事件达到了大屠杀的程度。

sentences.en: What atrocities do we not perpetrate in the name of culture and refinement!
sentences.zh: 我们在所谓的文化和 refinement 的名义下没有不犯下的暴行！
